messages.en: It's already pouring here. Have you left yet?
Not yet. I'm just waiting at home until the rain eases up.
What are you planning to do this weekend?
No plans yet. Let's just eat at that new place!
I'm not sure what the Islamic ruling is on this. I want to ask a religious teacher first.
Yeah, check first. Don't just go by what people post on WhatsApp.

collocations.en: a harsh punishment; a severe sentence

messages.en: Has Amir been punished for skipping class again?
Yeah, he only has to do an extra assignment this time.
